name: Create Pottery!
desc:
Welcome to Create Pottery!

🏺 Roll rare clay and shape it on the pottery wheel
🎨 Glaze your pieces and fire them in the kiln
💰 Sell your pottery to customers in your shop!
📱 Take jobs from your phone to earn gems
👩‍🎨 Hire employees to work for you!

Grow your little studio into a pottery empire! 🔥

llm.loop: roll rare clay -> shape on wheel -> glaze and fire -> sell to customers -> hire employees, grow studio
llm.objectives: grow a pottery studio into an empire
llm.progression: coins, gems, clay rarity, employees, shop
llm.instructions: roll clay, shape on wheel, glaze, fire in kiln, sell, take phone jobs, hire employees
unique: pottery wheel crafting with shaping and glazing steps
llm.thumbnails: SHAPE CLAY wheel closeups, finished glossy vases on a shelf, avatar at wheel
llm.complexity_notes: clay shaping deformation, multi-step crafting, NPC customers and employees
